decisions.reason: Adding supported Transak payment methods does not change the mint price or revenue-allocation rules.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Supported fiat payment methods do not alter referral-code identity, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
Supported Transak payment methods do not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout destination.
The fiat payment-method list does not change Big Block prize amounts, draw rules, ticket handling, or pool funding.
Supported fiat payment methods do not change the NFT metadata fields or their required accuracy.
The Transak payment-method change does not alter which NFT state or entitlements transfer on resale.
The fiat payment-method list does not change Small Block prize amounts, draw rules, ticket handling, or pool funding.
Supporting additional fiat payment methods does not change the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
Supported fiat payment methods do not alter badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain recording.
The payment-method change does not alter the required Base blockchain or Ethereum L2 network class.
Supported Transak payment methods do not change the deferred Discord community and support requirement.
